note: Post-freeze inputs of tools/release/release_rebuild.py --manifest. Copy this file next to the references, fill it in, run. head: the frozen commit of this repository (simulator source, release inputs, tooling); version: the image version (images/<bench>/VERSION); bench: the benchmark (default roboarc; release_rebuild.py --bench); onto: the commit whose scripts/<bench>/mk_tasks.py renders the task dirs (required; often the same as head); families: the subset of tools/release/mujoco_release.json to rebuild (all when absent); hf_revision: the dataset commit holding this run's uploaded instances (second run only); gpu: the device index for GPU-profile bases. bases: one entry per new base name that mujoco_release.json lists: reference = the recorded privileged.npz (relative to this file), sha256 = its sha256 (checked), expect = the end state_sha prefix the Harbor oracle must reach, instance = a made instance directory (optional), step_s = the measured wall time per control step (optional). records/freeze_manifests/ holds the manifests of the released freezes.
